mission: Attack artificial serialization. Find every place the current design makes the guide/Planner/local steward a bottleneck; propose evidence-backed distributed alternatives while preserving authority.

checkpoint_completion.evidence: Loaded binding Master Context, non-regression, verification/critic control, multi-surface plan, claim protocol, generated queue and current universal queue.
Observed live same-path 422 claim losses and two distinct-path/moving-main 409 write conflicts; inspected recent serialized main commit stream and prior Wave1 verifier.
Compared ALL_DEPENDENCIES_HAVE_RETURN local/cross-surface activation with current local-steward partial-input capability and dynamic readiness implementation.

Separated avoidable transport/barrier serialization from legitimate single-writer authority and final integration gates; Planner singleton assessed conditionally acceptable when deterministic/replayable.
Persisted deduplicated critic artifact; findings route into existing stress/page-integration/steward lanes rather than spawning duplicate work.

findings.finding: Current Git-main coordination transport couples disjoint worker writes through a moving branch head. Two 409 conflicts were observed in this run on paths that remained absent, distinct from desired 422 same-path claim losses. S4 must measure transport conflicts separately from semantic claim collisions before any transport replacement decision.

Local integration waits for nine complete dependencies even though local-steward code can safely reconcile partial candidate evidence and expose missing returns/conflicts. Introduce streaming candidate-only reconciliation while retaining one final completeness/authority gate.
Shared authority promotion, exact mutation ownership and final conflict resolution should remain single-owner/sequential. Parallelism should prepare evidence up to these gates, not duplicate them.
One canonical generation pin is acceptable if compile/review is deterministic and parallelizable; Planner must not become the universal serial executor.

proposal_dedup_note: No new opportunity emitted: F1 belongs in the already-defined 50-worker stress verifier/throughput critic until measured; F2 overlaps the active page-integration critic/local-steward lanes. Creating parallel tasks would duplicate prepared work.
negative_knowledge: 422 create-if-absent collision loss is normal and must not be mislabeled as infrastructure failure.
Two observed 409 moving-head conflicts establish a concrete scaling risk, not a measured 50-worker failure rate.
Final all-of completeness can remain; only pre-final candidate reconciliation should stream.
Single-writer authority gates are a correctness mechanism, not automatically a throughput bug.
truth_boundary: Critic evidence only. Does not promote /wc or /w, Current, Human Accepted or Served. F1 needs S4 stress measurement; F2 is supported by current queue policy plus executable local-steward capability.
